_help: Verb Hunt levels. To add a level, copy the whole { ... } block of Level 1, paste it after it (put a comma between the blocks), and change the text. 'answers' has ONE list per sentence, in order: list the verbs of sentence 1, then sentence 2, and so on (use [] for a sentence with no verbs). Write each verb exactly as it appears in the paragraph, without punctuation. If the same word appears twice in one sentence, list it twice to mark both; to mark only the 2nd one, write it as "word#2". Sentences are split at . ! and ? - if your paragraph contains abbreviations like 'Mr.' or 'e.g.', replace "paragraph" with "sentences": ["First sentence.", "Second sentence."]. Add ? after a word ("dressed?") for an arguable word that may be tapped or skipped without penalty. The verb total (e.g. 37) is counted automatically.
title: Verb Hunt!
tagline: Find every verb hiding in the story.

levels.title: The Unexpected Day
levels.paragraph: Sara was walking home when she noticed something unusual. A small crowd had gathered near the park entrance. Curious, she moved closer to see what was happening. A street performer was entertaining the crowd with a strange-looking machine. He explained how the machine worked and invited someone to try it. A little boy stepped forward and pressed a button. Suddenly, the machine began making a loud noise. Everyone looked surprised, but the performer remained calm. He quickly switched it off and examined the controls. The crowd started laughing when they realized that nothing dangerous had happened. Sara took out her phone and recorded the funny moment. Her friend, who had been watching from a distance, came running toward her. They talked about the machine while walking home. Later that evening, Sara showed the video to her family. Her brother laughed and asked her to send it to him. She promised that she would share it after checking the video. Before going to bed, she watched the recording again and noticed something funny in the background.
